The [[Salving Cactus]]es may burrow similar to [[wurm]]s for a short time. ** The area around [[Kepkhet Marrowfeast]] is likely the most difficult, as there are several [[Scarab Nest Builder]]s that cannot be [[pull]]ed away (but you can pull the boss). Ranged damage is best because the Scarab Nest Builders litter the area with traps. Consider clearing out the patrols around the boss before engaging. The patrols are hostile to non-scarab foes. ** The foes here use [[condition]]s liberally. Condition removal skills can be brought, but since they are reapplied very quickly, it is best to bring skills to counter [[health degeneration]]. ** The [[hydra]] [[boss]] (random [[profession]]) patrols a long route west of [[Augury Rock (outpost)|Augury Rock]] and might be missed. {{anomaly|Even if the player waits on the [[hydra]] [[boss]] route, the [[hydra]] may '''not''' approach the player on its own.}} {{anomaly|Various groups of patrolling [[Minotaur (Crystal Desert)|minotaur]]s are hostile to all foes, including other minotaurs.}} {{anomaly|If you start from [[Augury Rock (outpost)|Augury Rock]], [[Heroes' Audience]], or [[Vulture Drifts]] and kill all the foes south of the green oasis belt, '''sometimes''' the area is considered vanquished, even if there are still foes north of the line of greenery (the area outside of [[the Amnoon Oasis]]).}} {{Explorable areas in the Crystal Desert}} [[de:Pfad des Propheten]]
